steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each change in the law is matched to the policy it affects and to its review.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 change in the law affects no policy

findings.title: Change in the law with no affected policy
findings.fix: Name the policy the change affects

findings.title: Policy with no review after a change
Change with no source
findings.fix: Cite the source of the change

outcome.notChecked: The effect of each change on the organisation; changes not in the list.

pros: Checks a change with no source, a change with no affected policy, and a policy with no review after a change.

input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-policy-review skill on the records for this review.
